name: Gilt-Leaf Wood
description: The forest where Kirol is kidnapped by Lluwen.

description_citations.text: "Kirol". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Eidren orders hundreds of trees uprooted and rearranged into a beautiful pattern, creating the Gilt-Leaf Wood.
timeline.quote: Eidren, perfect of Lys Alana, ordered hundreds of trees uprooted and rearranged into a pattern he deemed beautiful.

citation.work: Leaf Gilder
citation.text: Leaf Gilder (Lorwyn, 2007), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The group reaches the Gilt-Leaf Wood, where Kirol lags behind and is seized by a silent hunter.
timeline.quote: a silent hunter rose out of the bushes behind Kirol and grabbed them, pulling them out of sight before they could make a sound.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 3: Aweary of This Moon
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 3: Aweary of This Moon" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Lluwen holds a knife to Kirol and demands to know what they know about why Isilu walks.
timeline.quote: I know you know why Isilu walks. I want to know what you know.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 3: Aweary of This Moon
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 3: Aweary of This Moon" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Lluwen takes Kirol prisoner to bring before High Perfect Morcant, and leads them deeper into the forest.
timeline.quote: High Perfect Morcant will want to see you.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 3: Aweary of This Moon
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 3: Aweary of This Moon" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Lluwen marches Kirol through the forest while they argue about hiking shoes and hooves.
timeline.quote: That's because you don't have feet,

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 4: Fetch Me That Flower
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 4: Fetch Me That Flower" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Sanar, Tam and Abigale realize Kirol is missing; Abigale resolves to find them and storms off alone.
timeline.quote: I'm going to go find them. You can wait here if you like.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 4: Fetch Me That Flower
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 4: Fetch Me That Flower" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: A beast with branch antlers emerges and flings Sanar into the trees.
timeline.quote: the motion causing one of its antlers to catch him in the chest and fling him away into the trees.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 4: Fetch Me That Flower
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 4: Fetch Me That Flower" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Abigale stumbles into the tributary and is swept toward the Wanderwine.
timeline.quote: As she stumbled, her foot hit the top of the sloping bank that led down to the water, and she fell.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 4: Fetch Me That Flower
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 4: Fetch Me That Flower" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Abigale conjures bubbles of air to breathe underwater.
timeline.quote: Her hands moved, and bubbles began to form around them, answering her call.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 4: Fetch Me That Flower
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 4: Fetch Me That Flower" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Tam and Sanar decide to find the waterfall instead of chasing Abigale, and Tam steps through the water.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 4: Fetch Me That Flower
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 4: Fetch Me That Flower" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Maralen finds a hidden coracle and the trio drifts toward the Wanderwine; Maralen explains Oona was her creator and she must prove she is not her.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 5: If We Shadows
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 5: If We Shadows" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Morcant and Lluwen force Kirol, bound, toward a grove claimed by Isilu to gather dawnglove.
timeline.quote: You're going to go inside and gather them for us.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 5: If We Shadows
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 5: If We Shadows" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Kirol finds the dawnglove flowers and is chased by cinders but escapes with a sprig.
timeline.quote: they burst through the veil of rainbows with the dawnglove in their hand

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 5: If We Shadows
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 5: If We Shadows" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Morcant orders Kirol back for more dawnglove; Kirol and Lluwen refuse.
timeline.quote: They don't deserve to die that way.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 5: If We Shadows
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 5: If We Shadows" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Ajani bursts in, drives back the cinders and defies Morcant, then takes Kirol away.
timeline.quote: My name is Ajani, and we are leaving.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 5: If We Shadows
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 5: If We Shadows" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Lluwen decides to follow Kirol and Ajani, abandoning Morcant.
timeline.quote: Lluwen had an instant to make up his mind.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 5: If We Shadows
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 5: If We Shadows" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: In the Gilt-Leaf Wood the elven hunter Lluwen kidnaps Kirol unnoticed by the others.
timeline.quote: Kirol was kidnapped by the elven hunter Lluwen

citation.work: Kirol
citation.text: "Kirol", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Morcant plans to poison Isilu with dawnglow and forces Kirol to harvest it; Ajani rescues Kirol from rimekin and Lluwen follows them.
timeline.quote: Kirol and Ajani fled the forest, and Lluwen decided to follow.

citation.work: Kirol
citation.text: "Kirol", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.quote: Thus the Gilt-Leaf Wood was born.

citation.work: Leaf Gilder
citation.text: Leaf Gilder (Lorwyn, 2007), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

citation.text: Lorwyn: card flavor text (Lorwyn, 2007), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.
